name: Sovos
summary: Sovos runs an e-invoicing compliance network with built-in Peppol connectivity and a separate eArchive product for more than 60 countries. It publishes no prices, and its site sends buyers to a sales call.

evidence.capability: compliance network for post-audit and CTC e-invoicing mandates

facts.text: Sovos says its Compliance Network helps businesses meet post-audit e-invoicing requirements and CTC mandates in 65+ countries, and it describes fully embedded PEPPOL connectivity. The page cites no sources for the country figure.

Sovos eArchive covers more than 60 countries. It offers global reach through a single API in clearance and post-audit countries, and it keeps the original invoice in its government-mandated schema, such as XML or PDF.
The Sovos home page lists a TCO calculator and a Book a Call button, and no price list.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: No prices are published on the pages we read
